text: AI is changing how we create art, music, and writing. Today, computer programs can paint pictures, compose songs, and even write stories. Some people worry that this will replace human artists, but others believe AI is just another tool. Human creativity comes from emotions, experiences, and imagination. A machine can copy styles and produce new combinations, but it does not feel joy, sadness, or love. So AI can help us make interesting things, but true creativity still belongs to people. Perhaps the best results happen when humans and AI work together.
